import numpy as np
from mvtnorm import *

print(ldpmvnorm(lower=np.array([[-1.0], [-1.0]]), upper=np.array([[1.0], [1.0]]), chol=ltMatrices([1.0, 0.3, 1.0], diag=True), w=np.array([[0.2, 0.5, 0.8]])))
